title.zh: 授予Narciso Padilla先生菲律宾国籍并使其成为菲律宾公民的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Philippine Citizenship to Mr. Narciso Padilla
title.orig: An Act Granting Philippine Citizenship to Mr. Narciso Padilla
title.vi: Đạo luật trao quốc tịch Philippines cho Mr. Narciso Padilla
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัญชาติฟิลิปปินส์แก่ Mr. Narciso Padilla
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan kewarganegaraan Filipina kepada Mr. Narciso Padilla

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3581_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Mr. Narciso Padilla is hereby granted Philippine citizenship with all the rights, privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1963.
